wip.title: Map — Work in Progress
wip.body1: This tab is still under active development. Some zones, icons, or overlays may be incomplete, misplaced, or missing entirely.
wip.body2: I apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience while I continue improving it.

legend.noIconsPlaced: No icons placed yet. Add icons from the editor panel.

referenceImage.hint: Import a screenshot to overlay it on the map as a positioning guide.
referenceImage.adjustOnHint: Drag or scroll the image to line it up. Turn off to click through and place points.
referenceImage.adjustOffHint: Clicks pass through to the map. Turn on to move/zoom the image.
